company.name: Dubai Verse Cup
company.shortDescription: Dubai Verse Cup is a digital horse racing and metaverse project that combines virtual racing events, blockchain-based digital assets.
company.description: Dubai Verse Cup is a virtual entertainment and horse racing initiative developed by DVCC. The project creates an online environment where users can participate in virtual horse racing activities, interact with digital assets, and access metaverse-based experiences connected to horse racing themes. The platform includes features such as virtual horse ownership, digital collectibles, online racing events, and blockchain-supported asset systems. It combines elements of gaming, sports entertainment, and virtual interaction within a browser and metaverse-oriented ecosystem.
